simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עֵין מִשְׁפָּט (H5880) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: עֵין מִשְׁפָּט (ʻÊyn Mishpâṭ) means En-Mishpat , a place near Palestine First listed occurrence: Gen 14 7.

definitions.full: H5880. En Mishpat מִשְׁמָּטּ עֵין proper name, of a location Gen 14:7 = (בַּרְנֵעַׅ קָדֵשׁ q. v. ( ᵐ5 τὴν πηγὴν τὴν κρίσεως ; on significance of name compare RS Sem i. 165, 2nd ed. 181 ).
